title: DiScammer Defender local completion record
body_md:
## Your local completion record

When the checkpoints below are green, you can create a personal record of the learning milestones you marked complete on this device.

To create it, you need:

- Every lesson in every module marked complete in this browser.
- A final self-assessment result of 80% or higher in this browser.

Enter the name you want to appear on the record. The record, its name, and its result are generated and stored locally in your browser. DiScammer does not receive, issue, sign, or validate them. Clearing browser storage or moving to another device can remove the record.

Use **Print / Save as PDF** to keep a personal copy if useful. This record is not a proctored result, verified credential, proof of identity, or proof of competence; do not present it as one.

## A short note on what you've practised

The nine modules return to one idea: *defence is process, not a badge.* Voice clones, deepfake videos, AI-personalised phishing, and multi-stage long cons all call for the same habits:

- Verify through a channel the attacker does not control.
- Do not trust the channel the request came through.
- Slow down. Time is the attacker's most expensive resource.
- Use tools that take the bravery out of asking — password managers, MFA, code words, and callbacks.

The record is a reminder of practice completed in this browser. What matters is carrying those habits into real decisions.
